name: cloudzero
description: CloudZero actual-cost plugin for FinFocus. Costs come from GET /v2/billing/costs. The v0.1.0 build is tested against documented responses, not a live CloudZero account.

apiKey.description: CloudZero API key. Sent as the Authorization header with no Bearer prefix. Required for cost RPCs.

baseUrl.description: CloudZero API origin, including the /v2 prefix.

costType.description: CloudZero cost_type. Default real_cost drops tax, support, and unused commitments.

currency.description: Currency label recorded on each result. The API does not return a currency.

resourceDimension.description: CloudZero dimension ID that identifies one resource. Cost RPCs decline when this is empty.

tagDimensions.description: Comma-separated tagKey=dimensionID pairs. Dimension IDs are not derived from tag names.

dailyBudget.description: Maximum cost and dimension requests this process will make. Default 50.

cacheTtl.description: How long a closed month of costs stays cached.

recentTtl.description: How long a cost row from the newest two days stays cached.
